biography.plain_text: Michael Vietri is a South African property entrepreneur and founder of Faircape Group. He started the business with borrowed capital and built a Western Cape portfolio spanning residential and commercial development. The group later expanded into retirement accommodation, healthcare and services for property owners, bringing an institutional investment partner into its retirement villages.

confidence.reason: Primary founder interview, company operating history and a signed CEO letter support the appropriately qualified narrative.

long_biography.plain_text:
South African property entrepreneur Mike Vietri gives ambitious department heads room to develop their businesses. At Faircape, he sees recruiting committed managers and allowing them autonomy as a way to retain talent. He has described its different service businesses as complementary parts of property development rather than unrelated investments.

His attention to staffing extended to meals in the group's retirement villages. After difficulties with a catering supplier, he brought waiters into Faircape's employment. He planned additional hospitality supervision and training, separating table service from kitchen duties. He accepted the prospective short-term cost to improve residents' experience of shared meals and recreation.
